description: Curated Event ID metadata for the technique investigation flowchart generator. Field lists are NOT derived from ATT&CK STIX (which supplies log source, channel, and analytic tuning parameters only). Each entry is hand-authored from the vendor documentation named in `source` and is limited to fields that appear in the event schema itself. Events cited by ATT&CK but absent from this catalog render without a field list rather than with invented fields.

provenance.windows_security: Microsoft Learn — Windows Security Auditing event reference
provenance.windows_powershell: Microsoft Learn — PowerShell logging (Module, Script Block, Engine lifecycle)
provenance.windows_system: Microsoft Learn — Windows System log (Service Control Manager)
provenance.sysmon: Microsoft Learn — Sysinternals Sysmon event schema

events.name: Process Creation
investigation: Identify the parent process
Review the full command line
Identify the executing user
Check the executable path and elevation
events.conditional: CommandLine is only populated when the 'Include command line in process creation events' policy is enabled.

events.name: Successful Logon
investigation: Check LogonType (3 network, 10 RemoteInteractive)
Correlate IpAddress and WorkstationName
Pivot on TargetLogonId to later activity

events.name: Failed Logon
investigation: Decode Status/SubStatus for the failure reason
Count distinct accounts per source IP
Compare against a later 4624 from the same source

events.name: Logon with Explicit Credentials
investigation: Compare SubjectUserName with TargetUserName
Identify the initiating process
Check whether the target server is expected for this user

events.name: Special Privileges Assigned to New Logon
investigation: Review PrivilegeList for sensitive privileges
Correlate SubjectLogonId with the matching 4624
Confirm the account is expected to hold these privileges

events.name: Scheduled Task Created
investigation: Parse TaskContent for the command and trigger
Identify the creating account
Check whether the task name mimics a legitimate one

events.name: Scheduled Task Updated
investigation: Diff TaskContentNew against the prior definition
Identify who modified the task

events.name: User Account Created
investigation: Identify the creating account
Check for a following 4728/4732 group addition
Confirm the account matches an approved request

events.name: Member Added to Security-Enabled Global Group
investigation: Check whether the target group is privileged
Identify who performed the addition
Correlate with a recent 4720

events.name: Member Added to Security-Enabled Local Group
investigation: Check for addition to Administrators or Remote Desktop Users
Identify the initiating account

events.name: Account Locked Out
investigation: Identify CallerComputerName as the lockout source
Correlate with preceding 4625 volume

events.name: Kerberos Authentication Ticket (TGT) Requested
investigation: Check TicketEncryptionType for weak ciphers
Check PreAuthType for disabled pre-authentication
Attribute IpAddress to a known host

events.name: Kerberos Service Ticket Requested
investigation: Flag TicketEncryptionType 0x17 (RC4) against service accounts
Count distinct ServiceName per requesting account
Attribute IpAddress

events.name: Kerberos Pre-Authentication Failed
investigation: Decode Status for the failure cause
Count failures per source IP and account

events.name: NTLM Credential Validation
investigation: Identify unexpected NTLM use where Kerberos is expected
Correlate Workstation with known assets

events.name: Network Share Object Accessed
investigation: Flag access to ADMIN$, C$, or IPC$
Attribute IpAddress to a source host
Pivot on SubjectLogonId

events.name: Network Share Object Checked (Detailed)
investigation: Review RelativeTargetName for sensitive files
Assess AccessList for write or delete intent
events.conditional: High volume; requires Detailed File Share auditing to be enabled.

events.name: Service Installed
investigation: Inspect ImagePath for suspicious binaries or encoded commands
Check StartType for auto-start persistence
Confirm the service is expected on this host

events.name: Audit Log Cleared
investigation: Treat as high signal
Identify the clearing account
Establish what activity preceded the gap

events.name: PowerShell Module/Pipeline Logging
investigation: Review Payload for invoked cmdlets and arguments
Identify HostApplication as the execution vector
events.conditional: Requires Module Logging to be enabled by policy.

events.name: PowerShell Script Block Logging
investigation: Read ScriptBlockText for the deobfuscated script
Reassemble multi-part blocks via MessageNumber and MessageTotal
Check Path for an on-disk script
events.conditional: Requires Script Block Logging to be enabled by policy. Warning-level blocks are captured even when only suspicious content triggers logging.

events.name: PowerShell Script Block Execution Start
investigation: Correlate ScriptBlockId back to the 4104 content
events.conditional: Only emitted when script block invocation logging is enabled; very high volume.

events.name: PowerShell Script Block Execution Stop
investigation: Bound execution duration alongside 4105
events.conditional: Only emitted when script block invocation logging is enabled; very high volume.

events.name: Engine Lifecycle Started
investigation: Check HostApplication for non-standard hosts
Flag EngineVersion 2.0 as a downgrade indicator

events.name: Engine Lifecycle Stopped
investigation: Bound the session alongside the matching 400

events.name: Attempt Made to Access an Object
investigation: Decode AccessMask for the requested rights
Identify ProcessName as the accessing binary
events.conditional: Requires a SACL on the target object.

events.name: Permissions on an Object Were Changed
investigation: Diff OldSd against NewSd
Identify who changed the descriptor

events.name: Process Creation
investigation: Review CommandLine and ParentCommandLine together
Compare OriginalFileName with Image to spot renamed binaries
Pivot on ProcessGuid across other Sysmon events

events.name: Network Connection
investigation: Attribute the connection to the initiating Image
Check DestinationHostname and port against expectations
Pivot on ProcessGuid to the creating process

events.name: Image Loaded
investigation: Flag unsigned or invalidly signed modules
Check ImageLoaded path against the expected location
events.conditional: High volume; typically requires targeted Sysmon configuration.

events.name: Process Access
investigation: Flag high GrantedAccess masks against lsass.exe
Inspect CallTrace for unbacked memory regions

events.name: File Create
investigation: Check TargetFilename against staging paths
Attribute the write to the creating Image

events.name: Registry Value Set
investigation: Check TargetObject against autostart locations
Review Details for the written value

events.name: Registry Key and Value Rename
investigation: Compare TargetObject with NewName
Attribute the change to the initiating Image

events.name: DNS Query
investigation: Attribute QueryName to the requesting Image
Check QueryResults for the resolved infrastructure
